headlines.title: Violent Protests Spread Across France Over Rising Cost of Living
headlines.description: Hundreds of thousands took part in weekend protests in France, fueled by the rising cost of living, in the country’s worst unrest in years. Demonstrations spilled over to other countries as well. NBC’s Raf Sanchez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Kornacki: Democrats Lead Polls as Midterm Elections Loom
headlines.description: NBC’s Steve Kornacki brings his big board to Studio 1A with a closer look at where things stand with just 15 days to go until the midterm elections.

headlines.title: Mystery Surrounds Deadly Accident at Youth Soccer Game
headlines.description: A kids soccer game in Kansas devolved into chaos when a black pickup truck plowed onto the field killing two people and injuring 10. Investigators say a 34-year-old woman was taken into custody and released pending toxicology results and a mechanical examination of the truck. They have not publicly named or charged the driver. NBC’s Maggie Vespa reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Russians locked out of bank accounts and apartments as Ukraine hits data centers
headlines.description: From accessing their money to ordering a taxi or takeout — millions of Russians were feeling the impact of Ukrainian strikes on the data centers of the country’s internet giant Yandex in their daily life.

headlines.title: NFL Week 6: The return of Caleb Williams, and life gets worse for the Rams
headlines.description: Week 6 of the NFL season featured a star player returning from one the season’s most dramatic injuries, an important game across the pond, and another devastating loss for a Super Bowl contender.

headlines.title: Presley Gerber’s Family Breaks Silence: ‘Beyond Heartbroken’
headlines.description: Nearly a month after the sudden death of Presley Gerber, mother Cindy Crawford, father Rande Gerber and sister Kaia Gerber are breaking their silence and sharing heartfelt remembrances. “We are so proud how he showed up in the world, with kindness and vulnerability,” his parents wrote. NBC’s Liz Kreutz reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: ‘The house was toast’: Surf swallows California homes
headlines.description: The worst of El Niño is still months away, but Southern California’s fragile coastline is already being transformed by record-setting king tides and storm surges.

headlines.title: Miley Cyrus Honors Late Godmother Dolly Parton With Emotional Performance
headlines.description: Miley Cyrus performed a passionate rendition of her “Aunt Dolly’s” classic “Jolene” during her performance at the Hollywood Bowl in Los Angeles.
